items.title: misaligned-half-points
items.claim: In Image #8, HasanAbi’s stacked half-point fraction extends well below the whole-number baseline in both the scoreboard and the central result.
items.reason: The staggered digits make the score harder to read at a glance.
items.suggest: Render the half point as an inline ½ glyph vertically centered beside the whole number.

items.title: small-stick-captions
items.claim: In Image #3, the STANCE and TECHNIQUE caption letters are approximately 10 pixels tall at the stated 390-pixel viewport width.
items.reason: These essential control labels are difficult to read on a phone.
items.suggest: Set the captions to at least 18 CSS px and adjust their spacing to accommodate the larger text.

items.title: duplicated-control-labels
items.claim: In Image #3, STANCE and TECHNIQUE appear both in the instruction strip and beneath the sticks, with the combined control area occupying approximately the bottom 274 pixels.
items.reason: Repeated labels consume space that could give the fighters more room.
items.suggest: Keep one label per stick and replace the separate instruction strip with concise instructions inside the control area.

items.title: button-covers-foot
items.claim: In Image #2, the FIGHT button hides Asmongold’s forward foot while his rear foot remains visible.
items.reason: The opening composition obscures the fighter’s stance and connection to the floor.
items.suggest: Reserve a clear action row below the fighters and move their presentation upward enough to prevent overlap.

items.title: kick-points-away
items.claim: In Image #18, Asmongold’s extended kicking foot points left while HasanAbi stands to his right.
items.reason: The winner’s displayed strike points away from the opponent, making the result pose visually confusing.
items.suggest: Replace the frozen kick on this result screen with a victory pose facing HasanAbi.
